about.body: The ZSD-420 is a Inline-4 (I4), 2.2L (2,198 cc), Diesel engine used across Jaguar's several model range, in production 2008–2010. We rebuild every ZSD-420 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The ZSD-420 is deployed across the ZSD-420 (ZSD-420 / ZSD-420, ZSD-420), the ZSD-420 (ZSD-420 / ZSD-420, ZSD-420), and the ZSD-420 (ZSD-420 / ZSD-420, ZSD-420). These form the core of the high-performance ZSD-420 range. More recently, the engine has been adopted for the ZSD-420 (ZSD-420, ZSD-420), the ZSD-420 (ZSD-420, ZSD-420), and the ZSD-420 roadster (ZSD-420, ZSD-420), proving the ZSD-420's versatility across different vehicle types.

compatibility.body: Because the ZSD-420 is fitted to six different models — from the compact ZSD-420 to the grand-touring ZSD-420 roadster — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and specific exact variant (e.g., "45" vs "45 S" vs "43"). A ZSD-420 from an ZSD-420 isn't a drop-in match for a ZSD-420 from an ZSD-420 — ancillaries and mounting differ.
